scope: Completed experiment audits, portable export checks, and standalone figure reproduction; this package does not rerun the experiments.

checks: Five complete phases per subject, variant, and seed
Raw and percentage budgets, active arm counts, model/prompt indexing, and regret identities
Subject-level means, standard errors, seed coverage, and paired differences from phase records
Equal-subject aggregate means and standard errors with full-coverage requirements
All five report CSVs copied unchanged from the independently audited report
Gittins filtered curve fields are unchanged from the supplied source rows

standalone_replot.pdf_validation: Both generated PDF files have valid headers and end markers. PDF bytes can differ because creation timestamps change.

integrity: FILE_MANIFEST.csv lists SHA-256 and byte length for every bundled file except itself. validate_bundle.py verifies each listed file.
